thread:
Tess M: Escalating: LuminaThera onboarding blocked. Their data ingest job fails during PII scan; legal flagged as high-risk. Support ticket #90011. Need CS to lead comms and coordinate legal + infra.
Noah B: Reproduced in prod sandbox. Scanner throws: "PII_RULE_FAIL: unlisted_id_type" on CSV import. Sample log:
```
2026-08-02T14:05:12Z ERROR pii-scanner rule_fail file=onboard_20260802.csv rule=unlisted_id_type
```
Ivy C: Customer uploaded payroll-like CSVs by mistake; they thought templates supported SSNs. They are in a regulated vertical. Legal wants retention paused and data quarantined.
Marco (AE): This account is Enterprise pilot, renewal conversation in 6 weeks. Execs are watching. CS please own the customer-facing message and the mitigation timeline. I'll join calls.
Tess M: Proposed comms plan: 1) Immediate ack + apology 2) Confirm we've quarantined data and paused processing 3) Provide ETA for safe deletion/ingest retry 4) Schedule remediation call within 24h.
Noah B: Technical mitigation: snapshot affected objects to quarantine bucket, disable downstream processors, and run strict schema validation. Engineering estimate ~45m for quarantine + lock.
Ivy C: I'll draft the first message and include Legal's ask: do not access raw files until Legal signs off. Legal Bot: @legal oncall looped - policy check requested.
Legal Bot: Legal review requested for LuminaThera (#90011): potential regulated PII ingestion. Please confirm retention policy and proposed quarantine steps.
Marco (AE): Customer wants a written note for their compliance team. CS please include: what we saw, immediate steps, and next steps with timing.
Tess M: Draft sent at 14:12 UTC: "We have paused processing and quarantined your upload. Our team will not access raw files until we align with your compliance leads. We estimate a safe remediation plan in 6-8 hours. Will update in 2h." Sending now.
Noah B: Quarantine completed 14:25 UTC. Processors disabled. Snapshot at gs://redwood-quarantine/lumina/90011_20260802.tgz.
Ivy C: Customer replied asking for proof of quarantine + timeline for removal. Also concerned about audit trail for legal.
Tess M: Providing audit links and a proposed removal plan: 1) Keep snapshot in quarantine for 7 days 2) If customer requests deletion, schedule secure wipe within 24h after confirmation 3) Offer a full compliance call with Legal + CS.
Legal Bot: Legal recommends secure WORM deletion option and a signed data handling letter before reprocessing.
Marco (AE): AE asks CS to coordinate a compliance call tomorrow EOD and to include an offer for a 30-day pilot extension if this affects their go-live.
Noah B: Will add additional logging and evidence for audit. Created ticket INC-90011-AUDIT with logs and GCS ACL changes.
Tess M: Next steps owners: Tess = customer comms & timeline; Noah = quarantine + audit evidence; Ivy = compliance coordination + schedule call; Marco = AE exec liaison. Escalate to VP-CS if legal sign-off not received within 12h.
Ivy C: Customer accepted the proposed call time. Legal floating a short questionnaire to confirm no sensitive SSNs were persisted.
Noah B: Confirmed: scanner flagged unlisted_id_type but no SSN regex matches. Sending sanitized sample to Legal for review.
Tess M: Customer update at 15:05 UTC: shared audit links, confirmed quarantine, scheduled call for 16:30 UTC. Customer appreciated speed and asked for onboarding checklist improvements.
Marco (AE): Good work. Postmortem owners: Ivy + Noah. CS to propose onboarding template change to explicitly warn about payroll-like files. Offer pilot extension if go-live delayed.
Tess M: Closing thread note: issue contained, compliance call completed, no SSNs persisted, LuminaThera accepted 14-day trial extension. Will file runbook changes and a short eval to catch similar uploads in onboarding QA. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
